name: Human owner withdrawal and exact supersession preserve requirement history
summary: A signed-in current human owner in simple mode may withdraw or supersede an accepted requirement. Any current owner can finish a pending transition from its exact durable receipt or abandon after a complete locked proof no state was written; released receipts retain the disposition. Original author, reason, successor and hashes are preserved. Member and proposal readers show terminal or unknown state without losing exact historical content; new incorporation is refused. Damage belongs to its own file/item. Compatible backup/restore preserves evidence and lineage. After the first terminal transition do not serve the project with an older kit: its reader refuses evidence, its writer can damage it and its restore accepts an unreadable backup.
